about_body:
Scriptly PC {version}

Records, transcribes, and summarizes any conversation on this computer - fully offline. No audio, transcript, or summary ever leaves this machine.
about_changelog_missing: CHANGELOG.md was not found next to the application.
all_filtered_as_noise: All recordings in this view are hidden by the "hide probable noise" filter. Turn it off above to see them.
already_running: Scriptly PC is already running in the background - look for its icon near the clock (it may be hidden in the overflow tray icons).
recording_size_limit_banner: Recording auto-stopped and saved after reaching the size limit set in Settings - turn it up if you need longer recordings.
delete_confirm_body: Permanently delete this recording and its transcript/summary? This cannot be undone.
diag_cloud_ok: Recordings folder is not inside a cloud-sync folder
diag_cloud_warning: Your recordings folder is inside a cloud-sync folder (OneDrive/Dropbox/etc). Transcription itself stays local, but the files themselves may get uploaded to the cloud automatically.
diag_disk_low: Only {gb} GB free - recordings may fail to save
diag_gpu_none: No NVIDIA GPU detected - transcription will fall back to CPU (slower)
diag_mic_invalid_selection: The selected microphone is no longer available - pick a new one in Settings
diag_mic_none: No microphone found on this computer
diag_ollama_missing_model: Ollama is running but model "{model}" isn't downloaded - run: ollama pull {model}
diag_ollama_unreachable: Can't reach Ollama - make sure it's installed and running (ollama serve)
diagnostics_intro: Verifies the local AI backend and everything Scriptly PC depends on.
digest_dialog_intro: One Word document covering several recordings: overview stats, all open tasks, and a short summary of each.
digest_generated_note: Generated locally from your own recordings - nothing here was sent anywhere.
digest_no_meetings: No recordings in this range yet.
discard_msg: Recording was too short and was discarded
error_no_audio_devices: No audio input devices found (microphone/system audio)
google_status_failed: Connection failed - check the Client ID/Secret
google_status_missing_creds: Enter the Client ID and Secret first
help_ai_tags: Uses the local summary to pick 2-4 short topic tags automatically (e.g. "billing", "renewal") - only applied if you haven't already set tags yourself.
help_ai_titles: Uses the local summary to name the recording (e.g. "Renewal call - Dana") instead of just the date and time.
help_appearance: System follows your Windows theme; Light/Dark override it.
help_auto_summarize: If off, recordings are saved but not processed automatically - useful to skip test recordings.
help_autostart: Scriptly PC will open automatically the next time you log into Windows.
help_custom_vocab: Names, product names, or jargon that come up often (comma-separated). Helps the AI transcribe them correctly.
help_dir: Where recordings, transcripts and summaries are saved on this computer.
help_floating_launcher: A small always-on-top button you can drag anywhere - click to start recording without the hotkey or the dashboard.
help_google_integration: Create a free "Desktop app" OAuth client at console.cloud.google.com (APIs & Services → Credentials) and paste both values here - this one setup step has to happen in your Google account, Scriptly PC can't create it for you.
help_hotkey: Press this combination anywhere on your computer to start or stop recording.
help_keep_audio: Keep the raw WAV file after processing. Off by default to save disk space.
help_language: Language of the app's buttons and menus. Does not affect transcription, which stays in Hebrew.
help_mic: Which microphone to record from. System audio (the other side of the call) is always captured too.
help_max_size: A very long recording is auto-stopped and saved once it reaches roughly this much memory, so a forgotten recording can't crash the app. Lower this on machines with less RAM.
help_min_duration: Recordings shorter than this are discarded automatically (e.g. an accidental hotkey press).
help_notification_style: How much Scriptly PC tells you via tray notifications when a recording starts/stops and finishes processing. Errors always show regardless of this setting.
help_start_minimized_login: Only applies when "Launch automatically with Windows" is on - the app starts directly in the tray on login instead of popping up a window.
help_ollama_model: The local AI model that writes the summary and extracts tasks. Must already be downloaded via Ollama.
help_speaker_labels: Detected automatically by comparing microphone vs. system-audio volume - no extra model needed. Works only when both are captured.
help_text_size: Makes the whole interface larger - takes effect after saving.
help_voice_commands: Adds a 🎤 button that listens for up to 60 seconds after you click it - not always-on. Say "start recording" / "stop recording" (English or Hebrew).
help_whisper_device: cuda uses your graphics card (fast); cpu works everywhere but is much slower.
hotkey_conflict_warning:
"{hotkey}" is commonly used by: {conflict}.

Using it here may stop that shortcut from working, or Scriptly PC may not receive it at all. Use this hotkey anyway?
hotkey_update_failed: Could not update the hotkey live. Please restart Scriptly PC.
no_meetings:
No recordings yet.

Click "Start Recording" above, or press {hotkey} anywhere, to begin.
onboarding_feat_floating: Show floating record button on desktop
onboarding_intro: Records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings and calls - fully offline, no account required. Let's set up a few quick preferences.
onboarding_no_mics: No microphones found - you can plug one in and pick it later in Settings.
onboarding_section_features_sub: Choose features to enable (all can be changed later in Settings):
pending_summarize_msg: Recording saved. Automatic summarization is off - click below when you're ready to process it.
quit_confirm: Quit Scriptly PC completely? Any active recording will stop.
settings_ai_tags: Generate topic tags for each recording automatically
settings_ai_titles: Generate a short title for each recording automatically
settings_auto_save_recordings_help: Automatically save all recordings without confirmation
settings_check_for_updates_help: On startup, checks GitHub for a newer version and shows a tray notification if one is available. No data is sent - just a read-only request to the public release list.
update_check_found: Update available: v{version} - opening release page...
update_available_body: Version {version} is available. Open Settings to download it.
settings_auto_update_help: When a new version is available, download it and install it silently the next time it's safe to restart (never while recording). Off by default - you can always update manually with "Update Now" below.
update_not_hosted: Scriptly PC {version} is available, but the installer isn't hosted here yet - check the GitHub releases page for how to get it.
update_ready_restart_confirm: Scriptly PC {version} has been downloaded and is ready to install. Restart now to finish updating?
update_ready_restart_later: Update downloaded - restart Scriptly PC when you're ready to finish installing it.
settings_auto_summarize: Automatically transcribe & summarize after recording stops
settings_floating_launcher: Show a floating record button on the desktop
settings_integrations_intro: Optional and off by default. Nothing is sent anywhere until you connect an account, and even then only a task you explicitly send - never a full transcript.
settings_notifications_enabled_help: Show desktop notifications after recording & processing
settings_privacy_note: Everything runs locally on this computer - no audio or transcript is ever sent to the cloud.
summary_error_body: Could not generate an automatic summary (check that Ollama is running and the model is downloaded).
summary_error_tasks: Could not be generated - see transcript.txt for the full transcript.
summary_no_content_body: This recording did not contain a substantive conversation (looks like a short test or silence), so no summary was generated. You can still read the raw transcript.
task_send_not_configured: Connect Google first in Settings → Integrations
tasks_empty: No tasks yet — they'll show up here once a recording is summarized.
tray_background_notice: Scriptly PC is still running in the background. Click the tray icon to reopen it, or right-click it to quit.
